summary: Golub Capital BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a Sixth Supplemental Indenture for the issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Notes due 2031. The notes are unsecured general obligations, rank senior to subordinated debt, and effectively junior to secured debt. Net proceeds will repay a portion of outstanding indebtedness under its JPMorgan senior secured revolving credit facility, with potential re-borrowing for general corporate purposes including portfolio investments. This is a routine debt financing and does not constitute a special situation; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction by the issuer.
